notes.detailedSummary: Theorem A of the 2023 BJ addendum applies to every numerical class without nefness, finite generation, countability or support restrictions. Corollaries 2.1–2.2 identify nonempty PSH exactly with pseudoeffectivity, construct V_theta=P_theta(0) on original X and prove divisorial normalized compactness. Its multiplier/base-ideal proof was retained. DXZ 2302.02541v3 defines big analytic finite energy and identifies psh cones on complex projective manifolds, so absence of any big E1 definition must not be claimed. DR 2603.25605v1 solves finite divisorial model data on smooth complex big varieties; MPN 2509.09442v1 retains a Kähler generic class. None of the inspected statements supplies the full original-carrier, arbitrary-field and arbitrary-admissible-support finite-energy theorem. This is a bounded literature audit, not proof of nonexistence of another theorem.
notes.text:
Retain k algebraically closed, trivially valued, characteristic zero, and X smooth connected projective. Use BJ's genuine PSH(c1(L)): decreasing generically finite section maxima on actual rational bundles with classes approaching c1(L), with the canonical actual-bundle reference. This includes singular common base loci, and imposes no finite generation assumption.

Boucksom–Jonsson, arXiv:2206.07183v2, submitted 6 September 2023 and PDF dated 7 September 2023, Theorem A proves the envelope property for EVERY numerical class on smooth X when char(k)=0 or dim(X)<=2. Thus in the retained field domain every big and pseudoeffective numerical class has the envelope property. Corollaries 2.1–2.2 say PSH(theta) is nonempty iff theta is pseudoeffective, V_theta=P_theta(0) is an actual genuine reference function, and the sup-zero PSH cone is compact in divisorial convergence. These are published results, not new equation theorems.

The retained full pertinent proof reduces to big rational classes and genuine PL obstacles. On a smooth SNC test configuration with actual generic bundle L, its total-space base ideals a_m, including horizontal base loci, give genuine same-L potentials phi_model+(1/m)log|a_m| increasing in the divisibility ordering to the section envelope. Multiplier ideals b_m satisfy a_m⊂b_m and b_ml⊂b_m^l. A fixed sufficiently positive equivariant ample total bundle A makes (mL+A)⊗b_m globally generated. Corrected genuine potentials phi_model+(1/m)log|b_m|+(1/m)phi_A decrease, with phi_A shifted nonnegative, in actual classes L+A/m tending to L. Varying-class closure gives a genuine original function. The section-envelope equality outside B_+(L), including all divisorial valuations, and divisorial determination identify it with the original envelope. Big references from above give the pseudoeffective V_theta; BJ 5.11 then gives compactness. This proof constructs no nonample finite-energy operator. The same addendum's Theorem B retains an AMPLE class.

Darvas–Xia–Zhang, arXiv:2302.02541v3, 17 July 2024, published CMH 100 (2025), 269–322, DOI 10.4171/CMH/586, Theorem 3.14 identifies compatible analytic test-curve PSH with BJ's original Berkovich PSH for pseudoeffective rational bundles on complex projective manifolds. Section 3.4 defines analytic big-class E1 by
I_NA(eta)=tau_plus+(1/V)∫_{-∞}^{tau_plus}(∫_X theta_eta_tau^n−V)d tau,
V=∫_X theta_Vtheta^n>0, with energy −∞ outside the I-maximal test-curve class. Finite energy forces eta_{−∞}=V_theta; Theorem 3.17 is its finite-energy-ray identification. A big E1 definition therefore exists over the complex field. The inspected units do not identify a general original-carrier NA raw intersection operator or an arbitrary-target inverse equation over every retained k.

Dervan–Reboulet, arXiv:2603.25605v1, 26 March 2026, assumes smooth COMPLEX projective X and big L. Definition 3.4 and Theorem 3.6 prescribe finite divisorial probability data by a compatible smooth dominant test configuration and a big real total bundle. Coefficients are b_i⟨L_total⟩^n·E_i/vol(L), retaining central multiplicities. Proposition 3.8 and the displayed boundary-preserving simplex degree-one proof were inspected. Their model output and finite target domain are not the requested arbitrary-support genuine E1 theorem. Source comments on nonuniqueness concern test configurations, not a disproved reference-preserving metric uniqueness theorem.

Mesquita-Piccione–Witt Nyström, arXiv:2509.09442v1, 11 September 2025, retains a Kähler GENERIC positivity class. Big total degeneration classes do not supply a big nonample generic-bundle result. Its hypotheses and theorem statement were inspected; no full proof or mathematical deduction from it is claimed.

notes.summary: Restricted actual nonnef endpoint: for X=Bl_pY and L=pi*A+aE, all genuine potentials are V_L+pi*PSH(Y,A), V_L=a log|s_E|; an intrinsic relative E1 equation on original X has raw mass vol(L), arbitrary finite quotient-dual-energy targets, comparison, attained solutions and uniqueness. It covers only this fixed-part domain; outer differentiation is proved for pulled quotient directions.
notes.detailedSummary: For any retained field, smooth connected projective Y of dimension n>=2, actual ample rational A and rational a>0, section factorization and compactness prove the entire cone equality without using a falsely decreasing corrected net. The actual quotient extends globally and is unique by divisorial determination. Its intrinsic energy is defined on X by bounded quotient floors and genuine nef intersection integrals, then shown equal to ample energy on Y. Original local L-weights equal H=pi*A weights off E using the actual section frame; their genuine finite-energy products extend nonpluripolarly by zero on E and have mass (A^n)=vol(L). The intrinsic target condition tests the actual global quotient and forces zero E-mass. The task-granted ample theorem yields genuine attained solutions and uniqueness, with actual original-carrier weak convergence and comparison proved. No general big bundle, arbitrary modification descent, full original C0 direction theorem or novelty of fixed-part removal is claimed.
notes.text:
Use the genuine cones and retained field scope described in n1, and the exact task-granted ample rational-bundle theorem only on smooth ample auxiliary Y. Let k be any algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, Y smooth connected projective of dimension n>=2, p∈Y(k), pi:X=Bl_pY→Y, E=P^{n−1}, A an ACTUAL ample rational bundle, a∈Q_{>0}, and an actual isomorphism L=pi*A+aE. Let H=pi*A, lambda=log|s_E| with the canonical section reference, sigma=a lambda. Every rational bundle B on X uniquely decomposes as pi*C+bE: push its divisor to smooth Y, and the remaining divisor is exceptional; restriction to an exceptional line detects b. The numerical decomposition is continuous.

For b>=0 and divisible m, H0(X,m(pi*C+bE))=s_E^{mb}pi*H0(Y,mC). To prove this, repeatedly use the divisor exact sequence and O_E(jE)=O_E(−j), which has no sections for j>0. At j=0, pi_*O_X=O_Y: regular functions off the removed codimension-at-least-two point extend on normal Y by its height-one valuation-ring characterization. Consequently h0(X,mL)=h0(Y,mA), vol(L)=(A^n)=V>0. L has degree −a on an exceptional line, so is nonnef; H has degree zero there and is not ample.

Given any genuine phi∈PSH(X,L), take its defining decreasing section net phi_i on actual B_i with c1(B_i)→c1(L). Write B_i=pi*C_i+b_iE, so b_i→a and C_i→A numerically. On a tail b_i>0. Literal section factorization gives phi_i=b_i lambda+pi*psi_i with psi_i genuine section-generated on C_i and sup psi_i=sup phi_i=c_i↓c=sup phi. Global section evaluation bounds psi_i<=c_i. Hence phi<=sigma+c off E, and phi=−∞ on E. The psi_i need not decrease; DO NOT use decreasing closure on them.

For a tail 2A−C_i is ample, so normalized psi_i−c_i lie in the genuine compact PSH_sup(Y,2A). Choose a convergent subnet with actual limit psi−c. For every rational 0<delta<1, a tail lies in PSH_sup(Y,(1+delta)A); that compact space is a closed subset of the Hausdorff 2A-space. Thus psi belongs to every (1+delta)A cone. Constant-scalar varying-class closure as delta↓0 gives psi∈PSH(Y,A). At each common divisorial valuation v, lambda(v) is finite and psi_i(v)→phi(v)−a lambda(v). Therefore genuine sigma+pi*psi and phi agree on all divisorial valuations, hence at EVERY original analytic point. Conversely addition and pullback give genuine membership. We have
PSH(X,L)=sigma+pi*PSH(Y,A).
All normalized phi are <=sigma, and sigma is feasible, so the actual intrinsic reference V_L=P_L(0) is exactly sigma. This map is a homeomorphism in common divisorial coordinates and preserves suprema.

Define Qphi=pi*psi as the unique genuine global H-psh extension of phi−sigma from X\E. This is an actual function; it never subtracts two −∞ values on E. Its uniqueness follows from divisorial determination. The actual section frame s_E identifies L|_{X\E} with H|_{X\E}; the raw metric weights of phi under this frame are those of Qphi. Thus their local products are genuine pulled ample intersection products, not assigned inverse measures. For bounded quotients the actual nef intersection product on X has mass H^n=V and pushes to the genuine ample product on Y, by model projection and decreasing approximation. The ample measure puts zero mass on the algebraic point p, so the X measure puts zero mass on E.

Point-nullness is justified explicitly rather than assumed from a support condition. A section of mA vanishing at p gives u=(1/m)log|s|−1<=−1. For alpha=1/(n+2), w=−(−u)^alpha is genuine A-psh by convex composition with slopes in [0,1] (extend the composition affinely from −1 to 0). Its capacity tail is O(t^(−1/alpha)), and the ample capacity-energy estimate integrates t^n times this tail; n−1/alpha=−2 makes the integral finite. Thus w is an actual E1 potential with w(p)=−∞. Every ample finite-energy mixed measure and every finite-dual-energy target integrates w, forcing zero p-mass. The retained source prints a larger power range; only this conservative directly integrable choice is used.

For unbounded finite-energy quotients, use these same local finite-energy products on O=X^an\E^an and extend by ZERO on E^an. They are positive Radon measures: O≅Y^an\{p}, and compact approximation away from the zero-mass point proves regularity. Call them M_sigma; pi_*M_sigma=M_A, and each raw mixed/top mass is V=vol(L). The reference fixed divisor remains in the actual metrics; it is removed only from the nonpluripolar measure, as required by its pole locus.

Here is an intrinsic original-carrier definition of the relative energy. Put q=Qphi, q_m=max(q,−m) in the NEF H cone, and phi_m=sigma+q_m, genuine on the actual L. Using bounded genuine raw H-products on X, set
E_sigma,raw(phi_m)=(1/(n+1)) Σ_{j=0}^n ∫_X q_m M_H(q_m^j,0^{n−j}),
E_sigma,raw(phi)=lim_m E_sigma,raw(phi_m).
Projection of the actual bounded products proves E_sigma,raw(phi)=E_A,raw(psi). Consequently the actual relative finite-energy locus is
E1(X,L;sigma)={genuine phi:E_sigma,raw(phi)>−∞}
=sigma+pi*E1(Y,A).
It contains unbounded quotients and is not restricted to bounded distance from sigma. It is not an abstract completion or the intersection of PSH(L) with an unrelated ample-generated energy vector space. The energy is concave, monotone, weakly upper semicontinuous and decreasing-net continuous, has E(sigma)=0, and shifts by Vc under addition of c. Its finite mixed difference formula integrates Qphi−Qphi′ against the actual raw mixed M_sigma products, with factor 1/(n+1), inherited from the genuine ample identity.

Unbounded decreasing nets have genuine original-carrier measure convergence. Their ample measures nu_j converge to nu and nu(p)=0. For F continuous on X, choose a continuous cutoff chi=1 near p with ∫chi dnu<epsilon. The bounded function (1−chi)F∘pi^{-1}, extended by zero, is continuous on Y. Weak convergence handles it; omitted integrals have absolute value at most ||F||∫chi dnu_j, with these tails tending to an arbitrarily small bound. Thus zero-extended products converge weakly on X, not merely after pushforward. This works for nets.

For any positive Radon mu on X of raw mass V define
D_sigma(mu)=sup_{actual phi∈E1(X,L;sigma)}
 [E_sigma,raw(phi)−∫Qphi dmu].
It equals E_A,raw^vee(pi_*mu). Thus finite D is equivalent to integrability of EVERY actual finite-energy quotient. The condition itself forces (pi_*mu)(p)=0 and mu(E)=0, because finite-energy ample targets do not charge algebraic pluripolar points. There is no additional silent support restriction; remaining support can be arbitrary. Raw phi-integrability is not substituted for quotient-integrability, since the fixed logarithm may have divergent integrals.

For finite D the granted ample theorem provides an actual attained E1 solution psi on Y for nu=pi_*mu. The actual phi=sigma+pi*psi is a genuine L-metric in the original relative E1 space. Its objective is the attained ample objective. Its locally proved product has pushforward nu and zero E-mass; because mu also has zero E-mass and the complements are isomorphic, MA_sigma,raw(phi)=mu on original X. Maximizing sequences have bounded quotient J, actual compact limits, finite energy by lower semicontinuity and attained objectives by target-integral continuity. No arbitrary lift is used. Equal measures imply equal ample quotient measures and hence equality modulo a single real constant. Comparison follows on O from ample comparison, and both measures vanish on E:
∫_{phi<phi′} MA_sigma(phi′)<=∫_{phi<phi′} MA_sigma(phi).
Strict-winning and mixed locality have the same genuine local interpretation.

For g∈C0(Y), the relative outer energy of sigma+pi*(psi+tg) is the ample outer energy, its actual envelope is sigma+pi*P_A(psi+tg), and both derivative signs give dE/dt|0=∫pi*g MA_sigma,raw(phi). These tests identify every admissible measure because E-mass is zero. A full theorem for EVERY nonpulled original f∈C0(X) is not established. Nor does this endpoint solve all big bundles; its single-point blowup fixed-part domain is explicit, and no novelty claim is made for fixed-part removal.

The complete proofs are in P16.5-argument.md Sections 3–5 and P16.5-paper.pdf. The genuine nonnef domain and all actual-bundle identities are explicit there. notes.detailedSummary: The fixed-part section computation gives L^n=(A^n)+(-1)^(n−1)a^n while vol(L)=(A^n), so top self-intersection cannot normalize a general big positive measure. The nef product example uses explicit generating FS potentials u_b with generic value 0 and value −b at t ord_D for t>=b; bounded nef genuine intersection measures are positive of total mass zero, hence both zero. This disproves uniqueness for the unchanged zero top operator, not every possible lower-degree replacement. For the actual trivial bundle in dimension n>=1, PSH(0)=constants, raw mass/energy/operator and sole positive target are zero; existence and uniqueness modulo constants are degenerate and no probability division is used. Finite rational computations only check displayed arithmetic.
notes.text:
The section factorization proved in n2 yields, for H=pi*A on Bl_pY and L=H+aE,
vol(L)=(A^n)=V,
L^n=V+(-1)^(n−1)a^n,
L·ell=−a on an exceptional line.
Indeed H|E is numerically trivial, so every mixed intersection containing H and E vanishes, and E^n=degree O_E(−1)^(n−1)=(-1)^(n−1). For Y=P2, A=O(1), a=1 this gives the actual big nonnef L=H+E with L²=0, L·E=−1 and h0(mL)=binom(m+2,2), so vol(L)=1. For a=2, L²=−3 while the volume remains one. These are positive-volume examples, distinct from zero-volume classes. The relative raw mass proved in n2 is the volume. A general big theory cannot simply replace its required volume by L^n or retain an intersection-based probability division.

For a genuine zero-volume example retain any algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero k, X=P1×P1 and actual L=pr1*O(1). It is nef semiample nonample, L²=0 and h0(mL)=m+1, hence vol(L)=0. Pull back generators s0,s1 from the first factor. Canonical generating section evaluation gives max(log|s0|,log|s1|)=0 at every analytic point. For b>0 define
u_b=max(log|s0|,log|s1|+b)−b.
Both u_b and zero are actual bounded genuine L-psh potentials, with −b<=u_b<=0 and sup u_b=0. Let D={s1=0}×P1. At the generic trivial valuation u_b=0. At v=t ord_D, log|s0|=0 and log|s1|=−t, so
u_b(t ord_D)=max(0,b−t)−b,
which is −b for t>=b. Thus u_b and zero are not equal modulo constants.

Their top measures are genuine zero intersection measures in an established domain: B=O(1,1) is ample and B−L is nef, so both bounded potentials are finite-energy B-psh and lie in BJ's ambient finite-energy vector space. BJ 7.18–7.19 gives positivity for the NEF L metrics and top mass L²=0. A positive measure of mass zero is zero, so
(c1(L)+ddc u_b)^2=(c1(L)+ddc 0)^2=0.
The unchanged zero top operator therefore fails injectivity modulo constants on this actual cone, and zero-mass probability normalization is undefined. This is not a counterexample to a properly specified lower-degree mixed or quotient replacement equation; no such general replacement is proved here.

The extra zero-volume equation range actually proved is the ACTUAL TRIVIAL bundle O_X on smooth connected projective X of dimension n>=1 in the retained field domain. BJ Corollary 4.24 says PSH(0)=constants. Its proof: each zero-psh phi is epsilon B-psh for every epsilon>0 and fixed ample B; at a divisorial valuation,
0<=sup phi−phi(v)<=epsilon T_B(v).
Let epsilon↓0 and use divisorial determination to obtain the same constant at all analytic points. Choose reference zero, genuine raw top operator zero and raw energy E_raw(c)=0 on actual finite constant metrics. The only positive Radon target of mass zero is mu=0, its dual energy sup_c(0−∫c d0)=0 is attained by all constants, and uniqueness modulo constants holds since the quotient cone is a point. No probability measure is introduced. Dimension zero is excluded because the empty product has mass one.

notes.text:
The canonical mathematical outcome is the incomplete original P16.5 result of n1–n3. No complete full-big rational-line-bundle theorem or unrestricted zero-volume equation is claimed.

Already established in the literature and usable on the full retained smooth projective pseudoeffective domain: genuine PSH, V_L=P_L(0), envelope regularity and normalized compactness, with no cardinality, toric, finite-generation or support restriction (n1). Actually proved here relative to the supplied AMPLE theorem: the explicit X=Bl_pY, L=pi*A+aE fixed-part endpoint, retaining the actual reference and bundle, raw volume mass, genuine original-carrier relative products, intrinsic quotient energy and target condition, attained equations, comparison and uniqueness, with differentiation for pulled continuous quotient directions (n2). The mass calculations, noninjective zero-volume cone and only the actual trivial-bundle degenerate zero equation are separate results (n3).

The precise unproved gates for every actual big rational L over every retained k are:
G1. Construct model-independent positive raw relative nonpluripolar products and an actual original-carrier E1 space retaining intrinsic V_L or an explicitly proved reference type; establish volume/relative mass and all genuine unbounded decreasing limits.
G2. Prove the full relative mixed-energy estimates, weighted continuity, locality, comparison/domination and two-sided outer differentiation for every continuous original-carrier direction, together with reference-preserving orthogonality.
G3. Prove the intrinsic target integrability equivalence, coercive bounds and target integral continuity; obtain an actual finite-relative-energy attained maximizer, identify its genuine original-carrier measure with both derivative signs, and prove uniqueness modulo constants.
G4. Establish G1–G3 for every retained field and arbitrary admissible support without replacing the whole domain by the complex test-curve construction, finite divisorial models, a finite-generation hypothesis or a fixed ample contraction.
G5. On additional zero-volume pseudoeffective classes give and prove an explicit replacement datum/operator, original carrier, auxiliary polarization if used, quotient reference, raw mass, target admissibility and injectivity. The raw zero top equation does not give uniqueness in a nonconstant cone.
